title: PokeEgg
description: PokeEgg is a plugin for servers where players have spawneggs which each have there own superpower such as a armadillo rolling and defending its owner.
body:
![Banner](https://i.imgur.com/oYJG287.png)
# PokeEgg
  PokeEgg is a plugin for servers that introduces PokeEggs (similar to Pokemon or Pokeballs) which can summon in mobs like Zombies that will fight for you and help you like Pokemon! The PokeEggs are infinite, the only thing that limits them is a cooldown and duration which is adjustable in the config. 

  FEATURES:
  - 5 different PokeEggs (as of now atleast)
  - Ability to configure duration and cooldown.
  - Custom Mob AI behavior for PokeEggs so they target correctly and easily.
  - and more to come because I cant name any right now.

Commands:
- Note that inf means it has no cooldown and is for debugging.
- /pokeegg give Player wolfegg
- /pokeegg give Player wolfegg inf
- /pokeegg reload
